I wonder if it was possible for me to do that with Visustella Battle Core Actions sequences or any other available plugin.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Should be possible with a combination of action sequencing and perhaps whatever their buffs and states core equivalent is.
I'm just talking off the top of my head here, but I think it should be possible to add a notetag to a state with a forced action on 0 HP.
Let's say you froze the enemy, in the frozen state, you add a notetag that simply says "If HP = 0 force action skill X"
Skill X being the action sequence for the death animation. That way, you can use the action sequencing to make it look however you want and simply kill off the enemy at the end of it.
This would mean you should probably make all enemies resistant to knockout by default, assuming you'll have a unique death animation for each situation.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Yeah don't VS action sequences have the setting to have immortal on? Then at the end you can check if the enemy hp is 0 and call a common event (where you can manipulate the enemy with action sequence commands) if that's the case. You can put collapse type 'none' on the enemies, so that they just disappear after.
